metadata.description: Skills for Claude Code and Codex, shared in the open.

plugins.name: best-coding-practices
plugins.description: Habits for writing and changing code: read first, match the codebase, keep diffs small, verify before claiming done.

plugins.name: auth-like-tony
plugins.description: Admin sign-in with Better Auth magic links, an ADMIN_EMAIL allowlist, nodemailer over SMTP, one shared Mailpit for every local project, requireAdmin() everywhere.

plugins.name: image-cropper
plugins.description: Image upload field: compress in the browser with compressorjs, crop at a fixed aspect with react-easy-crop, zoom-out-to-fit on white, re-editable crops, minimum-width gate, dual wide/square preview.

plugins.name: mobile-web
plugins.description: Web apps that feel right on phones: locked viewport scale, fields iOS will not zoom into, safe areas, bottom-sheet dialogs, scrolling tab rows, tables as cards, plus a headless-Chrome audit that signs in through the shared Mailpit and screenshots pages at phone width.
